tools.nyquistSub: Complex-plane stability plot for G(jω). Shows frequency response trajectory and the critical point (-1, 0).
tools.nyquistHelp:
Purpose: Used to evaluate closed-loop stability using the Nyquist criterion.
Interpretation: If the curve encircles the point (-1,0), the closed loop may be unstable depending on open-loop poles.

about.body:
I'm Altanbaatar Enkhsuld, an embedded control software engineer in the power electronics field. My interests include power conversion, control systems, and robotics.

This portfolio brings together my engineering projects, simulations, and technical writeups.

basics.title: Mathematics
basics.body: Engineering analysis relies on mathematical tools such as differential equations, Laplace transforms, and linear algebra. These methods allow dynamic systems to be modeled, analyzed, and designed using transfer functions, frequency response, and stability analysis.

basics.title: Physics
basics.body: Physical laws govern how electrical and mechanical systems behave. Concepts such as energy conservation, electromagnetic fields, inductance, capacitance, and semiconductor switching define how power electronic converters operate.

basics.title: Hardware
basics.body: Hardware implements theoretical designs in real systems. This includes power devices, gate drivers, sensors, passive components, and PCB layout. Thermal behavior, noise, protection circuits, and efficiency considerations strongly influence system reliability.

basics.title: Software
basics.body: Embedded software controls hardware in real time. Microcontrollers and DSPs execute control algorithms, manage PWM generation, synchronize ADC sampling, and implement protection logic. Deterministic timing and efficient code are essential for stable control systems.

basics.title: Validation
basics.body: Validation tests theoretical designs against real-world behavior. This includes simulation, benchtop testing, and fault injection. Validation identifies discrepancies, guides tuning, and builds confidence in system performance and safety.
